# 佛說浴像功德經

**ID:** T0697
**Volume:** T16
**Category:** 經集部類
**Original Category:** 經集部
**Byline:** 唐 寶思惟譯
**Dynasty:** 唐
**Date:** 702
**Juans:** 1

## Contributors
- 寶思惟 (A001922)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

T697 in one fascicle is the Tang-period rendering of the *Yùxiàng gōngdé jīng* by the Kashmiri translator [寶思惟](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AF%B6%E6%80%9D%E6%83%9F) / Ratnacinta (Manicintana / Ratnacintamanin), who arrived at Cháng'ān in 693 under Empress [武則天](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%AD%A6%E5%89%87%E5%A4%A9) Wǔ Zétiān and worked there until his death in 721. The Taishō places the translation in the Tiānzhúkè 天竺國 / Indian-translator workshop period at Cháng'ān, dated by the *Kāiyuán shìjiào lù* 開元釋教錄 ([KR6s0093](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6s/KR6s0093)) between 693 and the close of [武則天](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%AD%A6%E5%89%87%E5%A4%A9) Wǔ Zétiān's reign (706).

**Abstract**

The setting is Vulture Peak (鷲峯山) at Rājagṛha; the principal interlocutor is the bodhisattva *Qīngjìnghuì* 清淨慧 ("Pure Wisdom" — Sanskrit *Viśuddhamati*), who asks the Buddha "by what causes do all the Tathāgatas obtain a pure body?" The Buddha responds with a discourse on the merit of bathing Buddha-images: the rite produces purification of body, speech, and mind, generates the four bodhisattva-protections, and earns the practitioner the same merit as offering personal service to the Buddha during his lifetime. The text is the fullest of the Chinese-Buddhist Buddha's-Birthday image-bathing sūtras and supplies the Mahāyāna doctrinal framework for the *guānfó* / *yùfó* rite that the older [KR6i0385](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0385) / [KR6i0386](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0386) had recounted only narratively.

[寶思惟](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AF%B6%E6%80%9D%E6%83%9F) was a major late-seventh-century translator at the Wǔzhōu / Tang court, responsible for several dhāraṇī-class sūtras in the *Mìjiào* register; his rendering of the *Yùxiàng gōngdé jīng* is in the polished late-Tang Mahāyāna style. The same Indian sūtra was retranslated less than a generation later by [義淨](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%BE%A9%E6%B7%A8) / Yìjìng as [KR6i0388](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0388) (T698, also titled *Yùfó gōngdé jīng* 浴佛功德經).

Related canonical texts: parallel [KR6i0388](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0388) (T698); related image-cult cluster [KR6i0385](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0385) (T695), [KR6i0386](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0386) (T696).
